title_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in Tirana Entry! €117,990
description_en: The apartment has a total area of ​​87.4 m2, of which 74.1 is the net area of ​​the apartment and 13.3 m2 is the common area. The apartment is oriented to the west and is organized in a living room and two bedrooms, a balcony and two toilets. The apartment is located on the first floor and is sold together with a parking space at an extra price of €17,000.
